definition.delta_direction: candidate minus baseline for actions, state offset magnitudes and event times
definition.action_clock: action[t] uses public obs[t-1]; trace[t] is post-action state, trace0 post-stabilization reset
definition.shared_startup_gate: first4 actions and first5 pre-action observation digests equal; public state rows0..4 equal
definition.certified_same_full_observation: steps1..5 only, from saved public observation digests; later null, not inferred from proprio alone
definition.first_difference: first any exact nonzero component on common observed steps; no optimized epsilon; magnitude is reported and not a physical threshold
definition.paired_full_horizon: stop at min(baseline_steps,candidate_steps); separate from unpaired full-episode metrics
definition.release: first negative command strictly after first positive; not physical object release
definition.sign_switches: adjacent sign changes including zero, no initial switch
definition.close_duration_censor: run ending at observed episode/window boundary is right-censored; no imputed continuation
definition.missing_events: null with observed n/total/missing; one-sided order bounded only within the other observed horizon
definition.state_metrics: public joint/gripper offsets from common reset, path lengths and between-trajectory distances; not expert error/target geometry
definition.seed_groups: all three seeds separately, all60 pooled descriptively, all outcome strata including empty
definition.statistics: n/total/missing, mean/median/min/max; no significance, IID, causal root or outcome-independent validation claim
definition.decision: retain stop of routed candidate, no automatic training change; mechanism findings must precede a separately frozen hypothesis
definition.input_protection: metadata hashes before any episode JSON decode, no NPZ feature/head payload
